title: SKE Crystal Pro Pineapple Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods provide a simple and efficient way to enjoy clean, refreshing flavour without the waste of single-use disposables. Each prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, ensuring a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping experience with rapid nicotine relief. Pineapple Ice captures the bright and juicy flavour of ripe tropical pineapple, bursting with natural sweetness and a tangy citrus edge. A crisp, cooling exhale rounds off the flavour, enhancing its refreshing and uplifting character. Swapping pods is effortless—simply remove the empty pod and insert a fresh one. Whether you're looking for a more cost-effective alternative to disposables or a convenient way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide a mess-free and satisfying solution.
